criteria_table.name: C1_reacquisition_faster_than_acquisition_isolation_on
criteria_table.read: PARTIALLY TAUTOLOGICAL, same class as C2, caught by this autopsy's own red-team pass: r_acq_form=20 (=R_min) with ZERO variance across all 108 arms -- acquisition also sits on its own forced bar. So 'r_reacq (2/5/10/20) < r_acq_form (20)' is true by parameter choice whenever f_reacq<1, not an independent measurement either. The manifest's own criteria_non_degenerate flags C1 as non-degenerate (unlike C2), so this reading is NOT reflected in the manifest's own degeneracy check -- it is this autopsy's own finding, flagged here rather than silently deferred to the manifest's flag. C1's only non-trivial content is 'the variance/mean gates clear before the repetition count binds', which duplicates C5's genuinely non-forced signal. Do not treat C1 as independent load-bearing support for MECH-324 beyond what C5 already carries.

criteria_table.name: C2_reacquisition_scales_with_f_reacq_isolation_on
criteria_table.read: DEGENERATE -- scaling_rho_iso_on_w100=scaling_rho_iso_on_w30=0.9999999999999998, and all_iso_on_cells_sit_on_forced_bar=true: r_reacq lands EXACTLY on ceil(R_min*f_reacq) in every one of 24 isolation-ON W=100 cells and every isolation-ON W=30 cell (r_reacq_minus_forced_bar=0 throughout, confirmed by independent recomputation of the raw arm_results). The dissolution-scoped counter, by construction, fires the instant it reaches the threshold f_reacq encodes -- so rho=1.0 is an arithmetic identity of the counter design, not an independent measurement that the underlying REACQUISITION PROCESS actually scales with f_reacq in a biologically meaningful sense. The variance/mean gates on the isolation-scoped window clear well before the repetition count does in this harness, so the repetition count is the only binding constraint and the test cannot discriminate 'the counter correctly counts to threshold' from 'the underlying process is rate-limited at exactly that threshold for a reason connected to f_reacq's biological interpretation'.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-829a (2026-08-01, MECH-324 reacquisition-window-isolation-fix validation) confirms the use_reacquisition_window_isolation substrate fix (ree-v3 7747a01, 2026-07-31) works as designed: C1 (reacquisition genuinely faster than acquisition under the fix), C3 (retention-with-dormancy reconfirmed), C5 (paired isolation-on-faster-than-isolation-off), and C6 (isolation-off arm reproduces V3-EXQ-829's original flat signature) are all non-degenerate and passed. This is real, non-degenerate evidence that the FIX correctly removes the W-vs-f_reacq confound V3-EXQ-829 diagnosed, and that the underlying mechanism now shows the qualitative 'faster than acquisition' direction MECH-324 predicts. HOWEVER: C2 (reacquisition rate scales with f_reacq), the criterion meant to validate the claim's own QUANTITATIVE rate-scaling prediction, is DEGENERATE despite reading passed=true (interpretation.criteria_non_degenerate.C2=false; all_iso_on_cells_sit_on_forced_bar=true; rho=0.9999999999999998 is an arithmetic identity -- r_reacq lands exactly on ceil(R_min*f_reacq) in every tested cell because the dissolution-scoped counter necessarily fires at its own threshold once the fast-clearing variance/mean gates are satisfied, so the test cannot distinguish 'the counter correctly counts to threshold' from an independent validation that the underlying rate genuinely scales with f_reacq in the sense the claim's biological grounding intends). Note the run's TOP-LEVEL non_degenerate reads true, so a run-level gate reports clean over this degenerate load-bearing criterion -- the same pattern V3-EXQ-829's own autopsy warned against for self-routed labels generally. Correction to the prior claims.yaml note ('the queued validation experiment ran and confirms the use_reacquisition_window_isolation fix works as designed -- clean PASS, no anomalies'): 'no anomalies' is not accurate; the C2 anomaly is real and load-bearing, though it does not overturn the fix's own validation (C1/C3/C5/C6 remain genuine). MECH-324's rate-scaling prediction (f_reacq operationalised as a repetition-count reduction) therefore remains UNCONFIRMED by real evidence -- neither weakened further (829a does not reproduce 829's flat-signature defect under isolation ON) nor genuinely supported quantitatively (C2 cannot bear that weight). A redesigned validation criterion is needed: one that measures something the fixed counter's own threshold does not mechanically determine (e.g. an independent downstream behavioural-latency/rollout-cost signal that should improve in proportion to f_reacq once threshold is reached, or a prediction compared against an externally-derived rate rather than the counter's own defining formula).
